## What and why

- [ ] Describes the problem this PR solves and the change in one sentence per relevant commit.
- [ ] Points to the origin when there is one (a previous PR/issue; the origin ID in the Elixir Agent Kit).
- [ ] Elixir Agent Kit workflow applied: `<id do catálogo>` or `NONE` (a change bounded only by the contract and the gates). Cite the file read.

## Affected pipelines

Report the affected pipelines according to the [script matrix](https://github.com/sallaumen/agent-board/blob/main/PIPELINES.md#script-matrix).

## Validation

- [ ] Record the validated commit, the commands run, and their results, including the pre-flight required by the matrix.
- [ ] New or adjusted tests when the change alters behavior; no test disabled to go green.
- [ ] No artifact generated by validation entered the diff.

## CI

Record the CI state and the corresponding evidence. If it is unavailable,
follow the [canonical procedure](https://github.com/sallaumen/agent-board/blob/main/PIPELINES.md#if-ci-cannot-run-no-token-billing-or-runner).
